About SmartProp AI

SmartProp AI helps buyers and sellers estimate property prices using machine learning and live market data.

What you can do

  • List your house or land with photos
  • Browse Buy House and Buy Land with inline model estimates
  • Use dedicated prediction forms for quick estimates
  • Explore Market Insights to track average prices and listing trends

Tech stack

  • Frontend: React
  • Backend: Flask (5000 listings, 5002 prediction)
  • Database: MongoDB + GridFS
